blocks.orig: The Amani Villa is located at the Kilimanjaro Golf & Wildlife Estate – just 30 minutes from Arusha town and Kilimanjaro International Airport. The villa offers a peaceful place just off Fairway 5 of the 18-hole championship golf course, set amidst a beautiful garden with a lovely swimming pool. Built around a central courtyard with an adjacent dining room, the villa offers 7 rooms divided over two floors with either a view of the garden or the pool. All rooms are distinctively decorated in safari style with wooden furniture. Amani means peace in Swahili and that’s exactly what awaits you here.
blocks.html: The Amani Villa sits on the Kilimanjaro Golf & Wildlife Estate – only 30 minutes from Arusha town and Kilimanjaro International Airport. Just off Fairway 5 of the 18-hole championship golf course, the villa is a peaceful spot in a beautiful garden with a lovely swimming pool. Its 7 rooms are spread over two floors around a central courtyard with a dining room next to it, and look out over either the garden or the pool. Each room has its own distinctive safari-style decoration with wooden furniture. In Swahili, Amani means peace, and that’s just what you will find here.
